pages.title: Wooly Rhino
pages.text: The woolly rhinoceros was a member of the Pleistocene megafauna.$(br2)The woolly rhinoceros was covered with long, thick hair that allowed it to survive in the extremely cold, harsh mammoth steppe.$(br2)It had a massive hump reaching from its shoulder and fed mainly on herbaceous plants that grew in the steppe.
